notes: Pre copies the prologue's s_memtime s[8:9] / s_memrealtime s[10:11] (words 4, 6) plus the wait; the body itself reads s_memtime s[12:13] and s_memrealtime s[14:15] after a 2000-iteration loop and waits on lgkmcnt.

Columns 0..7 are clock values (0/1 memtime start lo/hi, 2/3 memrealtime start, 4/5 memtime end, 6/7 memrealtime end): NOT comparable value-for-value. Check() asserts only relations: columns 0..7 equal across each group of 8 lanes (uniform per wave), pair(4,5) >= pair(0,1), pair(6,7) >= pair(2,3), pair(4,5) != 0 and pair(6,7) != 0. Compare these relations, not values.
Column 8 (v5, moved to v18 by post) is exact: sum over 2000 steps of sum = (sum & 0xffffff)*3 + in[0] (v_mad_u32_u24), in[0] = tid + 1.
Loop branch at word 16 targets word 12, inside the body. Uses SGPRs s8..s16 only.
verified: disassembly (llvm-mc gfx1030) of words 9..29 and the prologue; Run() Fill() (words[0] = tid + 1) and Check() read; s_memtime/s_memrealtime exist on gfx103x (decoded with gfx1030)
